description.zh: 标准登录流程：输入校验 → 服务端认证 → 生成 Token → 跳转首页，含失败重试与连续 5 次锁定分支。
description.en: Standard login flow: input validation, credential check, token issuance and home redirect, with retry and five-failure lockout branches.

description.zh: 员工提交 → 直属主管审批 → HR/财务复核 → 归档；含驳回、撤回与超时升级分支。
description.en: Employee request, line-manager approval, HR or finance review, archive; includes rejection, withdrawal and timeout escalation.

description.zh: 选购 → 下单 → 支付 → 库存锁定 → 发货 → 收货；含支付失败、库存不足与取消分支。
description.en: Select, order, pay, reserve stock, ship, receive; with payment failure, out-of-stock and cancellation branches.

description.zh: 提交 → 构建 → 测试 → 安全扫描 → 预发部署 → 审批 → 生产发布 → 监控；含失败回滚分支。
description.en: Commit, build, test, security scan, staging deploy, approval, production release, monitoring; with a failure rollback branch.

description.zh: 从告警出发，按可用性、依赖、资源逐层判断，定位服务、数据库、缓存或网络问题并给出处置动作。
description.en: Start from an alert, branch by availability, dependencies and resources, and land on service, database, cache or network fixes.

description.zh: 客户端 → API 网关 → 用户/订单/支付服务 → 各自数据库 + Redis + 消息队列，含配置中心与可观测性。
description.en: Clients, API gateway, user/order/payment services, databases, Redis and message queue, plus config center and observability.

description.zh: 浏览器 → CDN → 负载均衡/Nginx → 应用集群 → 数据库与缓存，含对象存储、日志与监控。
description.en: Browser, CDN, load balancer, app cluster, database and cache, plus object storage, logging and monitoring.

description.zh: 业务库/日志/第三方数据 → 采集 → 清洗转换 → 数仓分层（ODS/DWD/DWS）→ BI 报表与数据服务。
description.en: Sources (OLTP, logs, third party), ingest, clean and transform, warehouse layers, BI reports and data services.

description.zh: 用户、商品、订单、订单明细四张核心表，标注主键、外键与基数关系，可直接改字段。
description.en: Four core tables — user, product, order, order item — with primary keys, foreign keys and cardinalities.

description.zh: 用户、前端、API、认证服务、数据库五条生命线，展示登录请求、凭据校验与 Token 返回的时序。
description.en: Five lifelines — user, frontend, API, auth service, database — showing the login request, credential check and token response.

description.zh: CEO 之下产品、研发、测试、运营四个部门及下属小组的汇报关系，适合改造成自己团队的结构。
description.en: CEO with product, engineering, QA and operations departments and their sub-teams; easy to reshape for your own team.

description.zh: 用户、客服、技术支持、系统四条泳道：提单 → 受理 → 排障 → 回复 → 关单，含升级分支。
description.en: Four lanes — user, support, engineering, system — from ticket creation through triage, troubleshooting, reply and closure, with escalation.
